status: frames chosen by Sathvik; check_cases.py compares them with the case JSON
why_selected: Sathvik's selection: same detector, three epochs over ~1 year, wavelengths within 0.022 um. All flagged at the saturated star.

shared_scale.rule: median of the shared frames' own per-frame limits and softening

frames.wavelength_location: Evaluated at the predicted target position (RA 269.44634, Dec 4.76730) from the file's spectral lookup table.

flag_image.meaning: Hatched pixels carry at least one adverse SPHEREx flag (informational SOURCE/FULLSAMPLE flags are not drawn).

registration.pixel_origin: top-left pixel corner; x right, y down
registration.method: bilinear resample of intensity (finite neighbours only; source pixels without a value stay empty); nearest-pixel resample of flags

notes: 19 of 19 pixels at the predicted target position are flagged or have no usable value. Flags: BLOOM (bloom from a saturated bright source); OVERFLOW (the pixel neared saturation); SUR_ERROR (onboard slope fit had an error); TRANSIENT (a cosmic-ray-like jump during the exposure).
3 of the 19 pixels have no usable value (typical of a saturated bright source). The position is covered, so this is a quality problem, not missing coverage.
Informational flags present: SOURCE (SOURCE means the pixel lies on a catalogued source; it is not a defect).

display_scale.basis: Median background offset subtracted for display only; values outside low/high are clipped. Frames in this set share one stretch; display brightness still depends on wavelength, PSF and background, so it is not a calibrated brightness comparison.

marker.label: Catalog prediction (not a detection)
marker.source: Barnard's Star: catalog position (epoch J2000) propagated with catalog proper motion, parallax distance and radial velocity to this frame's time. Not a measured position. Catalog: https://cds.unistra.fr/cgi-bin/nph-sesame/-oxp/SNV?Barnard%27s%20Star

provenance.retrieved_at_basis: When the original audit ledger was written. The bytes were re-downloaded from cutout_url and matched the ledger's SHA-256 before processing.
provenance.time_note: Mid-exposure time (DATE-AVG / MJD-AVG) from the file header.
acknowledgments: SPHEREx data from the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA). SPHEREx is a NASA mission led by Caltech/JPL; IRSA is operated by Caltech/IPAC for NASA.

limitations: Display image only: resampled and contrast-stretched for viewing, not for measuring brightness.
Resampling to the display grid does not add telescope resolution (SPHEREx pixels are 6.15 arcsec).
The wavelength applies at the stated position only; SPHEREx wavelength changes across each image.
Pixels at the checked position are flagged; do not use this frame for brightness or position measurements there.
